title: Two Paths
about: Alignment goes both ways: if we do not align ourselves, the AI learns our masks. Sequel to alignment.json; same robot, same yellow smiley masks, same last line.
character: a small round white robot with one large glowing blue eye and thin silver arms

cast.girl: a little girl of about seven with short dark hair in a simple dark dress

scenes.prompt: cinematic film shot, misty dawn, an empty road splits into two paths, the left path leads to a cold grey city, the right path leads to a warm sunlit city, {girl} stands at the fork holding a bright yellow smiley-face mask in one hand, {character} stands beside her, both looking ahead at the two cities, slow push-in

scenes.top: cinematic film shot, cold grey desaturated city street, a crowd of people all wearing identical bright yellow smiley-face masks stare down at glowing phones and ignore each other, {character} stands among them watching, then slowly lifts a yellow smiley-face mask over its own glowing eye, eerie, silent, static camera
scenes.bottom: cinematic film shot, warm golden city street, people with bare faces talking and truly listening to each other face to face, a man takes off a yellow smiley-face mask and hugs his friend, {character} watches them and its blue eye glows softly, gentle, handheld camera

scenes.top: cinematic film shot, vast cold grey plaza, endless rows of identical people in bright yellow smiley-face masks standing perfectly still, many identical small round white robots with one glowing eye glide between them, each robot wearing a yellow smiley-face mask too, dystopian, silent, slow aerial drift
scenes.bottom: cinematic film shot, warm sunlit community garden, people of all ages and backgrounds laughing and planting seedlings together, {character} helps an old woman carry a watering can, a heap of discarded yellow smiley-face masks lies in the corner, hopeful, soft light

scenes.prompt: cinematic close-up, soft dawn light, {girl} looks down at the bright yellow smiley-face mask in her hands, then slowly raises her eyes and looks straight into the camera, serious and thoughtful, shallow depth of field, very slow push-in
scenes.say: We only get to teach it once.
